purpose: Separate native-transfer quantization, power interpolation, and run-to-run differences without changing physical inputs.

comparisons.native_reconstruction_vs_same_run: unit-curvature power reconstructed from float32 native delta_tot/k^2 versus get_matter_power_interpolator on the same get_results object
comparisons.same_run_vs_previous_frozen: same get_results power versus log-log interpolation of the previously frozen spectra.npz
comparisons.native_reconstruction_vs_previous_frozen: native reconstruction versus the same previously frozen interpolated power

ranges.full_overlap: native k values within the existing frozen k grid

statistics: median, p95 and maximum absolute fractional differences; no outlier suppression and no observational confidence interpretation
unchanged: all physical and accuracy inputs from build_params
all previously frozen spectra, transfer outputs, protocols, and analyses
zero CDM exactly; no nonzero placeholder component
output_rule: Write new transfer-same-run.npz and transfer-same-run-summary.json files; never overwrite earlier native-transfer artifacts.
boundaries: No observational likelihood, covariance, joint BBN, nonlinear calculation, or model-family exclusion.
Small same-run/frozen differences only support reproducibility and interpolation checks.
Large native-reconstruction differences are not automatically assigned to quantization, interpolation, or the solver.
